+/** Safe RegExp construction to prevent ReDoS from $data patterns (CVE-2025-69873). */
+
+const MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH = 1000
+
+/**
+ * Returns a RegExp if `pattern` is safe to compile and use, otherwise null.
+ * Rejects invalid syntax, overly long patterns, and patterns with nested
+ * quantifiers / quantified overlapping alternations that cause exponential
+ * backtracking.
+ */
+export default function safeRegExp(
+  pattern: string,
+  flags = ""
+): RegExp | null {
+  if (typeof pattern !== "string" || pattern.length > MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH) {
+    return null
+  }
+  if (!isSafePattern(pattern)) {
+    return null
+  }
+  try {
+    return new RegExp(pattern, flags)
+  } catch {
+    return null
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Heuristic star-height / overlap check.
+ * Strips escapes, then rejects nested quantifiers and quantified alternations
+ * whose branches can overlap (classic ReDoS shapes such as (a|a)*, (a+)+, etc.).
+ */
+function isSafePattern(source: string): boolean {
+  // Drop escaped pairs so character-class / meta analysis sees real structure
+  const s = source.replace(/\\[\s\S]/g, "x")
+
+  // Nested quantifiers: (a+)+, (a*)*, (a+){2}, (a{1,})+, etc.
+  if (/\((?:[^()]|\([^()]*\))*[+*?]\)[+*?{]/.test(s)) return false
+  if (/\((?:[^()]|\([^()]*\))*\{[\d,]+}\)?[+*?{]/.test(s)) return false
+
+  // Quantified group that contains alternation — check branch overlap
+  const quantifiedAlt =
+    /\(([^()]*\|[^()]*)\)(?:[+*?]|\{[\d,]+})/g
+  let m: RegExpExecArray | null
+  while ((m = quantifiedAlt.exec(s)) !== null) {
+    if (alternationOverlaps(m[1])) return false
+  }
+
+  return true
+}

+function alternationOverlaps(body: string): boolean {
+  const alts = body.split("|")
+  // Duplicate branches: (a|a)*
+  if (new Set(alts).size !== alts.length) return true
+  // One branch is a prefix of another: (a|ab)*, (a|)*
+  for (let i = 0; i < alts.length; i++) {
+    for (let j = 0; j < alts.length; j++) {
+      if (i !== j && alts[j].startsWith(alts[i])) return true
+    }
+  }
+  return false
